a pull request that changes one root plans that root alone, and its plan note covers it alone
/terragucci plan on a pull request re-plans it in a run of its own, and the re-plan edits the plan note
with locks: plan a pull request locks the root it plans, and a second one reaching that root fails terragucci/lock and is answered with the root and the holder
a pull request that replaces a table fails terragucci/plan under the Rego policy on main, and its plan note names the denial

the plan job holds a GitHub-signed OIDC token for this repo and run, for the plan role, and the apply job on main one for the apply role; with no cloud account the token is checked, not traded with STS
a merged destroy stops its wave with the approve command, and after a sealed chant approve the re-run applies it
the plan note ends with the terragucci footer, and its taco image answers 200 with a PNG
the plan note counts the tips the run report holds, and each tip in the report names its rule and its page

a /terragucci agent comment pushes the commit of the stand-in agent onto the branch of the pull request, which plans again, and the reply links it; an ask whose change touches the pipeline is refused and nothing is pushed

a wave the policy denies applies once the approver policy.override lists overrides its plan with terragucci override, and the report names the override; an override by someone it does not list counts for nothing

two merges pushed back to back apply in the order they arrived, the older run applies nothing beside the newer one except a wave that stands down for it, none is cancelled, and each commit ends with a terragucci/apply success
/terragucci apply on a merged pull request applies it again from its merge commit, and while its wave waits it applies nothing and gives the approve command; on an open pull request it is refused
terragucci approve in a clone approves the waiting wave with no digest copied, and the re-run applies it; with --dry-run it records nothing
the drift job opens the drift issue, a second run updates that issue, and a run that finds no drift closes it

with apply.when: pull-request a second pull request that reaches a root an open one applied is refused with the root and the holder named, and applies once the first is unlocked with /terragucci unlock
a comment on an approved pull request whose head is behind main is refused as not up to date, and nothing applies
with apply.merge: auto a comment on an open, approved pull request applies its head in every wave, and pr-merge merges it with the job token
with apply.merge: auto and merge_token_env the merge is made with that token, so the merge commit starts its own run on main
with modules.publish: git-tags a conventional commit to a module on main makes the publish job push the module tag
once the roots pin that tag and the next version is published, terragucci rollout --mode apply opens one pull request for the canary wave that moves those pins alone
after a refused wave the explain-refusal job of the refused-wave guide runs, and its respond wave-refused step names the root that moved; a stand-in takes the place of the model step
